title: Problem Details
description: RFC 9457 Problem Details error body, extended with a stable error_code and correlation_id, per ADR-0004 Section 9.

title.description: Short, stable, safe human summary. Clients must not branch on this text.

status.description: HTTP status repeated as an integer.

detail.description: Safe occurrence-specific explanation. Clients must not branch on this text.

error_code.description: Stable machine-readable UPPER_SNAKE_CASE extension. Clients make decisions from this field.

correlation_id.description: Lowercase UUIDv7 for support and trace correlation. Always the current invocation's effective value (see ADR-0012).

details.description: Bounded array of documented validation-detail objects.

path.description: JSON Pointer path to the offending field.
